name: Sawai Yutaka
source:
The protagonist's classmate and one of the few delinquent students at this school. He spends most of his time fighting and is often suspended, so he rarely comes to school.

However, since Yuuko became his homeroom teacher, he has been attending school diligently(?), as if he had found a good plaything.

[from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11746]official site[/url]]
